The governing WP8 assurance contract requires synthetic tiers to measure peak memory.
The current implementation assigns peak_memory_bytes = max(component_bytes.values()), where component_bytes are canonical serialized payload lengths.
The materialised capacity evidence therefore records a deterministic serialized-component-size proxy under a field named peak_memory_bytes rather than an actual peak-memory measurement.
PRSCOperationalBudget freezes its peak_memory_bytes limit from that proxy. This is a correctable measurement-conformance defect, not an integrity/security/authority incident.

blocking_findings.finding: WP8 labels max canonical serialized component bytes as peak_memory_bytes. This does not satisfy the assurance contract's requirement to measure peak memory before freezing the operational budget.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Replace the serialized-component-size proxy with a measurement that actually measures the declared peak-memory quantity under the pinned execution environment; regenerate capacity evidence, operational budget, mechanical bundle and QA; rerun affected tests and exact-head assurance; then resubmit PRSCI-G8-ALG.

nonblocking_observations: The defect was explicitly disclosed in the WP8 QA/review packet rather than concealed.
No protected-source survivor, authority escalation, semantic mutation, hidden top-N, family shrink or optimized-path false allow was found.
Because the defect is measurement conformance and is repairable inside WP8, QUARANTINE is not warranted.
rollback: Forward-only; preserve WP1-WP7 and G0-G8 evidence. Correct WP8 capacity measurement without changing the frozen contract or scientific scope.
